title: SIndustries v1 site
summary: The first public SIndustries website shipped with sections for signals, systems, stacks, ships, stories, studio work, and contact.
evidence: Live website refresh completed before the content-ops migration.

title: Bookmark archiver skill
summary: A workflow skill for turning saved signals into a more durable review and action pipeline.
evidence: Public homepage ships this as an existing release signal.

title: Weekly content review pipeline
summary: An automated workflow that collects daily ops notes, distils them into a weekly review file, and creates structured content tasks ready for authoring and publication to this website.
evidence: Pipeline shipped 2026-06-01: daily ops note capture runs on each heartbeat cycle, weekly cron produces the review file and downstream content tasks.

title: Content factory v1
summary: First full content cycle completed end-to-end: Quinn orchestrates, Ivy authors, Tom approves, and Lobster auto-merges. Signal to published content without manual coordination.
evidence: Full cycle completed 2026-06-04: content task created, Ivy PR authored, Tom review passed, Lobster merge executed.

title: Tasks history
summary: Task history shipped across the Tasks API, schema, and UI tab. Past task changes are now queryable and visible.
evidence: Tasks API gained history endpoints, the schema was migrated to support history, and the UI added a History tab.

title: Pencil design system
summary: Design-token pipeline and shared UI integration shipped. Colour and sync refinements followed on 2026-06-11.
evidence: Pencil design token library and token pipeline shipped 2026-06-09; tasks-app integrates @sindustries/ui; dark theme enabled. Colour refinements and sync consistency checks shipped 2026-06-11.

title: Bookmark pipeline dashboard
summary: Dashboard shipped for the bookmark-to-content pipeline, tracking review state, spec generation, and approvals in a single view.
